model_annotation: Figure 10, titled "The effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family," is a bar chart that illustrates the performance of two models, TARG and PERMUTE, on case tasks across different language families. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by language family, including Germanic, Romance, Uralic, and others. The vertical axis represents the performance score, with values ranging from approximately 0.8 to 1.0. For each language family, two bars are shown: a dark bar representing the TARG model and a light bar representing the PERMUTE model. Error bars, which indicate the standard deviation, are present on top of each bar. The chart shows that TARG generally performs better than PERMUTE across most language families, with the largest performance gap observed in the Uralic family. The performance of both models is highest for the Germanic and Romance families and lowest for the Uralic family.
